reports.announcement:
Big news: Nex Coder 3.8 Preview — Neptune by @Zorix is currently #1 in CRUXEval with 98.1 pts (AutoEval).

Nex Coder 3.8 Preview — Neptune currently leads Zorix Nex Coder 3.7 Pro (Max) by 4.0 pts in this published ranking.

Note: this is an automated evaluation score rather than a final live-human ranking. Scores may move as additional evaluations or human votes are collected.

Congrats to the Zorix team on the result!
